summary: Frontend-only re-validation after API-layer refactor. Tested Dashboard, Students, Student Profile (Add Note mutation), Daily Tracker, Leaderboard, Announcements (publish + pin toggle mutations), Reports, and Settings (save profile + notifications + theme toggles + persistence). All critical flows work. No React console errors observed. No direct src/data/* imports from pages/components (API layer is the sole data source).
action_items: Optional: testid naming mismatch — request referenced `toggle-settings` but actual testid is `theme-toggle-settings`. Behaviour works correctly; consider aligning testid name or updating docs.
